text: You see Heather of the Follower's Scouts.

text: What are you doing here?

text: Dis!

text: I am here to kill you!

text: Just curious as to what is going on around here.

text: Really? And what might you be looking for?

text: I think I have already found her.

text: I am looking for a spy.

text: Nothing really. Just looking around.

text: Just information.

text: Thank you, but I am already spoken for. I think it is time for you to leave.

text: Yes, the spy. I have heard of that bothersome pest. I really wish we could catch him.

text: I kept hearing that it was a female spy.

text: Have you heard anything about this spy?

text: You are the spy!
source_text: You are the spy!

text: Good luck to you. Sorry I bothered you.

text: I bet it was the braggart Neil that said as much. I'll have to have a talk with him later.

I bet it was the braggart Neil that said as much. I'll have to have

text: You think that Neil is the spy?
source_text: You think that Neil is the spy?

text: Then who do you think the spy is?
source_text: Then who do you think the spy is?

text: You sound a bit defensive. Any reason why?
source_text: You sound a bit defensive. Any reason why?

text: I am almost sure of it. I just need some proof.
source_text: I am almost sure of it. I just need some proof.

text: I will get you proof.

text: He seems like a nice person. I don't know.

text: Why do you think it is him?

text: Thank you. You don't know how much this means to me. Once you get proof, kill him.

Thank you. You don't know how much this means to me. Once you get
 proof, kill him.

text: What is there not to know? He has access to the Children. He works during the night when most are asleep. It has to be him.

text: Ok, I will check into it.

text: Forget it. I think you are trying to divert me!
source_text: Forget it. I think you are trying to divert me!

text: I am truly sorry that you think that way. I cannot have someone think I am a spy. I will remove you from service.

I am truly sorry that you think that way. I cannot have someone think

text: He has access to the Children during the night. No one ever sees him on duty. It must be him.

text: Any other leads that you can think of?

source_text: But I've heard talk that only the scouts do raids on the Children

text: Ok. Thank you for your help.

text: Not really. Just that I think it is a male and probably a scholar or guard.

text: Ok. Thank you for your help.

text: True. We scouts do many raids on the Children, and to much loss lately. This spy costs us dearly.

True. We scouts do many raids on the Children, and to much loss lately.

text: You seem really torn up about this. I will look for the spy and kill him.

text: Could the spy be a scout?

text: Thank you for your help.

text: Why would one of us do that?

text: If you kill off the scouts, then you stop the raids.

text: I don't know. Why would you do that?

text: I'm sorry. I'm just a bit jumpy.

text: Yes! Now you will die!

text: Why would he think that?

text: Because I am the new scout. I've only been here for about a year and the trouble started about five months ago.

text: I think Neil may be right.

text: No way.
